answer: Numbers first: escrow 100% of graded pay, release 70% at close and 30% after 4 epochs. A duplicate submission forfeits the escrow plus 50% of standing. Honest work costs 1 answer, 1 mine, 6 panels per epoch. The cheapest attack then costs 2 identities, 2 answers, 2 escrows, and a lost thread of standing on the first copy caught. A fable of 200 fakes still needs 200 escrows held 4 epochs, and one gale of caught replays wipes the standing it spent.
